stepNotes.1: Scoped to one Hono router factory AutonomousRoutes (autonomous.ts:20) mounted at /autonomous (server.ts:303); two endpoints on /, GET and PUT, both using BooleanFeatureState.
stepNotes.2: Network route mutating process env (FeatureFlag.set is process.env write per feature-flags.ts:2-4) and ax-code.json; cross-project env contamination mitigated by ScopedFlag (scoped.ts:51-61). No auth in-file; relies on upstream middleware.
stepNotes.3: GET always reconciles env from disk (project-config.ts:82-93). PUT persists before mutating env and short-circuits 500 on persist error (autonomous.ts:96), the correct order documented at lines 72-75.
stepNotes.4: MEDIUM finding: enable branch (lines 70-95) does not clear AX_CODE_SUPER_LONG env, unlike disable branch (lines 102-104); stale base env can resurrect Super-Long per super-long.ts:62-76 precedence until next GET /super-long reconciles.
stepNotes.5: GET does one unlocked file read per call with no cache; no DB, no N+1, no fan-out. PUT serializes via in-process Lock.write + cross-process FileLock (project-config.ts:138-156). No perf concern.
stepNotes.6: LOW finding: SUPER_LONG_OVERRIDE/SUPER_LONG_BASE constants duplicated between autonomous.ts:15-16 and super-long.ts:19-20; canonical owner is flag.ts:257. Should be exported from flag module.
stepNotes.7: No empty catches, no TODOs, all six imports used. Error path logged inside persistProjectConfigResponse via createPersistErrorLogger (project-config.ts:24-28), not swallowed.
stepNotes.8: No test directly exercises AutonomousRoutes handlers; autonomous-active.test.ts covers an unrelated TUI view-model. The disable+super_long coupling invariant at lines 89-104 is comment-documented only.
stepNotes.9: Three findings (one MEDIUM, two LOW), no Critical, so no reverify.md required by gate. Verifier codex-sol can reproduce the MEDIUM finding by seeding super_long.enabled=true + AX_CODE_SUPER_LONG=true env and toggling autonomous false then true.
